title: Choose the visual world for design-system.wpei.me (revised from your reference)
question: Three versions of your reference's product-UI landing page, each corrected for what is true today. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Rule specimen (light)
options.lineage: Linear and Geist product pages; your reference's top row
options.thesis: A working record table you can switch between loaded, loading, partial, error and no-permission, with the rule behind each state cited beside it.
materials: white panels on a near-white ground
options.viewport: Headline, purpose and Watch on GitHub on the left; on the right a state switcher over a record table and a rule card quoting its source (Linear Peek); 'Docs coming soon' is a status, not a link.
options.risk: Closest to the familiar SaaS split hero; the live state switch is what keeps it from being any other registry.

options.label: Install panel (dark)
options.lineage: Vercel and shadcn/ui dark launch pages; your reference's middle row
options.thesis: Leads with how the registry is installed, by a person or an agent, with a record detail panel and its composition rule below.
options.viewport: Headline left; right a terminal with the real command form (pnpm dlx shadcn@4.21.4 add) marked 'Available when the first item ships', a record detail panel and a Stripe Apps ContextView rule card.
options.risk: The install command is the focal point while the registry has zero items, so the hero leads with something a visitor cannot run yet.

options.label: Disclosure layers (light)
options.lineage: your reference's bottom row; Primer and Geist docs
options.thesis: One record shown at three disclosure depths, row, hover card and side panel, numbered in order, with the rule areas and their sources beside it.
options.viewport: A wide headline across the top; below it a numbered row → hover card → side panel sequence; on the right the four rule areas, each linked to a real source (Geist, Stripe Apps, Primer, Carbon).
options.risk: Static layers explain disclosure but do not let the visitor operate it unless the panels become live.

canonCard.label: The category standard (shadcn/ui, Geist, Base UI)
canonCard.thesis: A centred launch page at the craft of ui.shadcn.com, vercel.com/geist and base-ui.com.
canonCard.viewport: A centred badge, headline, purpose line and GitHub button, with three rule-area cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other shadcn registries by design.
